title: [C&C] FootKiss & Shoe Worship Suite
description: Drop-in footwear script suite with proximity kneeling, kiss animations, configurable tribute-per-kiss charges, Bento shoe-shine props, and pedestal worship integration.

features.title: Proximity Sensor & Force Kneel
features.desc: Detects nearby submissives and smoothly triggers kneeling postures.

features.title: Tribute-per-Kiss Fees
features.desc: Configurable L$ charge each time a submissive touches or kisses the footwear.

features.title: Bento Shoe Shine Auto-Props
features.desc: Auto-attaches polishing rag and brush props for realistic worship roleplay.

features.title: Sim XP Multiplier
features.desc: Earns bonus Control & Chaos XP for both participants on successful worship.

sections.title: 1. Overview & Setup
sections.content: The **[C&C] FootKiss & Shoe Worship** system can be dropped into any modifiable heels, boots, or shoes. It turns any pair of footwear into an automated FinDom revenue generator and worship station.

sections.title: 2. Configuration & Tribute Settings
sections.content:
### Step 1: Drop Scripts into Footwear
Drag `C&C_FootKiss_Core.lsl` and animations into your modifiable shoes.

### Step 2: Configure Price & Radius
Click the shoe > **Config Menu** to set price per kiss (e.g. L$50, L$250) and trigger radius (1m - 5m).

chat_commands.desc: Opens the footwear worship configuration dialog.
